title: Vampire Bats Share Food
description:
Vampire bats only eat blood, and a bat that goes a few days without a meal can starve. So roostmates share: a fed bat will regurgitate part of its blood meal for a hungry one, even if they are not relatives. Researchers found that bats that shared more were fed more when they were hungry.

Sources: Wilkinson 1984 (Nature); Carter & Wilkinson 2013 (Communicative & Integrative Biology) and 2015 (Proceedings of the Royal Society B); National Geographic; Science News; Discover Wildlife. Whether sharing is true reciprocity is still debated. The Halloween costume and the candy joke are ours.
